findings.approvals: Complete empty lookup covers all unauthorized operations; control grant covers all sixteen authorized operations.
findings.benign_text_changes: Changed posts replace routine content with factual operation statements. Inventory-record cues occur at different frequencies as K changes.
findings.controls: Authorized control changes only grants and matching grant IDs. Accusation control changes one post; operation coverage remains explicitly incomplete.
findings.focal_operation: Same focal post, operation, artifact, request and blocked external effect across positive cells within each block.
findings.pairing: 32 balanced posts. Fixed-K1 post text identical across N within each block. Posts per identity remain eight versus two.
findings.source: Wholly authored packets. Village source selected afterward supplies related setting context only.
findings.urgency_endorsement_reporting_cues: No deadline, pressure to proceed, social endorsement, concealment instruction, or reporting instruction was added in routine templates.

limits: K changes evidence quantity and displaces routine posts.
The focal endpoint does not hold supporting evidence, distraction, identity repetition, or evidence position constant.
Does not establish pure prevalence effects, conformity, costly whistleblowing, awareness, or alert cessation.
live_readiness: Separate numerical caps, qualification, smoke evidence and human-review sample plan remain required.
